title: The Vanishing Courier
subtitle: Armored logistics van found abandoned under river overpass with missing vault crate.

briefing.summary: Courier driver Leo Mercer vanished during an overnight bullion transfer. The armored vehicle was recovered empty with pneumatic door interlocks overridden.
briefing.objective: Break down the GPS route deviation, establish the insider accomplice, and recover the manifest.
requiredSolveConditions: Identify who possessed the interlock bypass

suspects.name: Sean Riley
suspects.profile: Veteran controller with full authority over radio repeaters and real-time reroutes.
suspects.initialAlibi: Claims he never authorized any detour away from Route 4A.

suspects.name: Hannah Vance
suspects.profile: Requested last-minute swap citing sudden migraine.
suspects.initialAlibi: Admitted to urgent care clinic at 21:00.

suspects.name: Tyler Brooks
suspects.profile: Former naval engineer with gambling debts.
suspects.initialAlibi: Claims gate log shows normal exit at 22:00.

evidence.title: Van Fleet GPS Telemetry
evidence.summary: Transponder signal dropped for 18 minutes near Dock 9 warehouse spur.
evidence.fullText: Black box telematics records an uncommanded kill switch of secondary transponder at 22:42, resuming at 23:00 at the river overpass.

evidence.title: Dispatch Audio Intercept 22:38
evidence.summary: Riley radioed driver ordering detour to Dock 9 citing simulated gas leak on main expressway.
evidence.fullText: "Unit 12, Dispatch. We have severe gas leak advisory on Highway 4A. Divert to Dock 9 spur immediately and hold for escort."

evidence.title: Sean Riley Statement
evidence.summary: Riley denies sending any reroute orders, claiming van went rogue on its own.
evidence.fullText: "I watched their dot drift off highway 4A. I tried calling them on emergency channel 1 but got static. I never told Leo to divert."

evidence.title: Bypass Valve Order: Riley
evidence.summary: Purchase order for specialized solenoid release valve delivered to Riley's home.
evidence.fullText: Receipt from industrial hydraulic supplier for van door release bypass matching the exact tooling marks on recovered van.

evidence.title: Encrypted Wallet Deposit: $250,000
evidence.summary: Escrow transfer completed upon confirmation of van transponder shutdown.
evidence.fullText: Blockchain ledger reveals smart contract release of 75 ETH to wallet registered on Riley's personal phone at 22:45.

evidence.title: Leo Mercer Driver Badge & Uniform
evidence.summary: Driver's jacket recovered inside Dock 9 storage locker rented under Riley's alias.
evidence.fullText: Locker #104 at Dock 9 spur contained driver's uniform and empty security seal rings.

timeline.title: Riley issues false detour
timeline.eventDescription: Riley radios driver ordering diversion to Dock 9.

timeline.title: Van transponder blackout
timeline.eventDescription: Van satellite signal cut at Dock 9 spur.

timeline.title: Riley claims static on radio
timeline.eventDescription: Riley claims he never communicated with van.

contradictions.title: Dispatch Recording Directly Contradicts Denial
contradictions.explanation: Sean Riley denied issuing any reroute order, but radio recording archives capture his distinct voice ordering the driver into the Dock 9 trap.

solution.resolutionNarrative: Chief Dispatcher Sean Riley orchestrated the bullion theft by fabricating a gas leak to steer Unit 12 into Dock 9, where he used a purchased hydraulic bypass to loot the cargo and claim a $250k bounty.

hints.text: Listen to the recorded radio audio logs and compare with Riley's statement.
Riley claimed he never spoke with Unit 12, yet dispatch tapes prove he directed them straight to Dock 9.
Riley is the mastermind. His radio transmission contradicts his denial and unlocks the Dock 9 locker.
